final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT "ANA Pattern", AVG("aCL IgG") as avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE "ANA Pattern" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "ANA Pattern"), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1."ANA Pattern", step1.avg_acl_igg, step1.avg_acl_igg - step2.overall_avg as diff_from_overall FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_acl_igg > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as avg_step3_col2 FROM step3) SELECT step3."ANA Pattern", step3.avg_acl_igg, step3.diff_from_overall, step3.avg_acl_igg - step4.avg_step3_col2 as final_diff FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4
